entities.summary: Sophie Rois (b. 1961-06-01, Ottensheim) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Ottensheim and Austria. Known in the fields of austria, composers & musicians, europe.
